units: <cite ref="Shabbat 109b">Sabb. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>גי׳ דאסניתא</he> (ed. <he>גו׳ דאסינתא</he>) the paring of &c., v. <cite ref="A02471"><he>אַסְנִיתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:13">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>גְּרָדָא דיבלא וגי׳ דאסנא</he> (Ms. M. <he>גררא … וגוררא</he>, early ed. <he>וגורדא</he>) scraped root of cynodon and the paring of the bramble.

<cite ref="Sotah 10b">Sot. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:24">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (prov.) <he>קמי דשתי חמרא חמרא קמי רפוקא גי׳ דיבלא</he> before wine drinkers, place wine; before a ploughman—a dish of scraped roots &c. V. <cite ref="C01271"><he>גַּרְדָּא</he></cite>.
